crossRefs.note: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine…
“For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will…
“I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who…
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the…
They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought…
and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on the earth.”
After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could count, out of every nation and of all…

translations.web: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.
translations.bsb: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
translations.kjv: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
translations.asv: Let them give glory unto Jehovah, and declare his praise in the islands.
